lede: Every OpusClip plan, what each credit pack costs, and the cheapest plan for the minutes of video you turn into clips each month.
calc_label: OpusClip credits you need each month
calc_note: 1 credit = 1 minute of video processing. The calculator uses Free, Starter and Pro with 1 to 5 credit packs of 300 credits a month, the Pro options offered on both monthly and yearly billing. Starter is monthly only, so on yearly billing the calculator picks Free or Pro. On yearly billing Pro goes up to 15 packs, 4,500 credits a month.

after_plans: On yearly billing, Pro ($14.50/month, $174 a year paid up front) costs less than Starter ($15/month, monthly billing only) and includes twice the credits. Pro on the card is for 1 credit pack, 300 credits a month; each extra pack adds the same price, as in the table. Yearly Pro is billed $174 a year per pack, with 3,600 credits over 12 months, and goes up to 15 packs ($2,610 a year for 54,000 credits). Unused Pro credits roll over for 1 month on monthly billing and 2 months on yearly. Starter and Pro come with a free trial, no credit card required.

faq: Free is $0 with 60 credits a month. Starter is $15/month for 150 credits, on monthly billing only. Pro is $29/month per pack of 300 credits a month, or $14.50/month per pack billed yearly ($174 a year). Business pricing is custom.
1 credit = 1 minute of video processing. Pro credits come in packs of 300 a month: up to 5 packs on monthly billing and up to 15 on yearly billing.
On Pro, yes: unused credits roll over for 1 month on monthly billing and for 2 months on yearly billing.
Yes. The Free plan is $0 with 60 credits a month, clips up to 1080p, auto reframe and AI captions. Clips carry a watermark, there is no editing, and after 3 days clips can no longer be exported.
